grammar.title: 形容词的三种比较形式
grammar.structure: 较高：more expensive / the most expensive；较低：less expensive / the least expensive；平级：as expensive as
grammar.definition: 形容词的比较形式有三种：较高比较级（more + 原级）、较低比较级（less + 原级）、平级比较级（as + 原级 + as）。
grammar.usage: 单音节词常直接加 -er/-est（cheap—cheaper—cheapest），多音节词用 more/less/most/least。

examples.en: This model's less expensive than that one.
examples.zh: 这种型号比那种便宜些。

examples.en: It's the most expensive radio I've ever seen.
examples.zh: 这是我所见过的最贵的收音机。

grammar.title: 平级比较：as ... as
grammar.structure: A + be + as + 形容词原级 + as + B；否定式：A + be + not as + 形容词 + as + B
grammar.definition: as ... as 表示「A 跟 B 一样……」；表示「A 不如 B」只需在 be 动词后加 not。
grammar.usage: 两个 as 中间必须用形容词/副词原级，不能用比较级。

examples.en: The green apple is as sweet as the red one.
examples.zh: 这个绿苹果同那个红苹果一样甜。

examples.en: The blue car is not as clean as the red car.
examples.zh: 蓝车没有红车干净。

grammar.title: 购物与付款用语
grammar.structure: How much does it cost? / It costs + 金额 / buy ... on instalments / pay a deposit of + 金额 / can('t) afford

grammar.usage: 打八折：20% discount；付定金：pay/put down a deposit

title: The most expensive model / as ... as
subtitle: 最昂贵的型号 / 和……一样

lead.question: 在电器店里看中一台电视机，问价钱、嫌太贵、又想分期付款——「多少钱」「买不起」「值这个钱」「分期付款」用英语怎么说？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象一家电器行：你指着最好的型号问 How much does it cost? 店员报出 500 英镑，太太说 We can't afford all that money（我们花不起）。店员再推荐便宜些的——But it's not as good as the expensive one（当然不如贵的好）。这里出现了三种比较：more expensive（较高）、less expensive（较低）、as good as（平级）。先试着把「这个和那个一样贵」翻译成英语，再听弗里斯一家的购物记。第 112 课把三种比较铺开操练。
goals: 能用 How much does it cost? 问价，用 It costs ... 报价
掌握三种比较形式：more expensive / less expensive / as expensive as
能用 not as ... as 表示「不如……」
学会购物付款表达：buy on instalments, pay a deposit, afford
lead.summary: 第 111 课弗里斯先生看中店里最贵的电视机（500 英镑），太太说买不起；店员介绍便宜些的型号（300 英镑），但不如贵的好。先生认为贵的那种值这个钱，问能不能分期付款——先付 30 英镑定金，然后每月 14 镑，3 年付清。太太抱怨丈夫总想买最好的，「你以为自己是百万富翁」，先生幽默回敬：百万富翁是不分期付款买东西的！第 112 课操练 cheaper/more expensive、not as ... as 与最高级。
lead.tips: ① 问价三连：How much does it cost? / How much is it? / What's the price?；② 三种比较：more expensive（较高）、less expensive（较低）、as expensive as（平级），否定平级在 as 前加 not；③ afford 常与 can/can't 连用：can't afford 买不起；④ on instalments 分期付款；pay a deposit of ... 付……的定金；⑤ it's worth the money 它值这个钱；⑥ 比较级中第二次提到的名词用 one/ones 代替（that one, the red one）。

questions.q: Can Mr. Frith buy the television on instalments? How does it work?
questions.zh: 弗里斯先生可以用分期付款方式购买电视机吗？如何操作呢？
questions.a: Yes, he can. He pays a deposit of thirty pounds, and then fourteen pounds a month for three years.
questions.aZh: 可以。先付 30 英镑定金，然后每月 14 镑，3 年付清。
questions.hint: 听店员回答 Of course 之后的那句。

questions.q: How much does the most expensive model cost?
questions.zh: 最贵的那种型号要多少钱？
questions.hint: It's the most expensive model in the shop. 之后的那句。

questions.q: What's wrong with the cheaper model?
questions.zh: 便宜些的那种型号有什么不足？
questions.a: It's only three hundred pounds, but it's not as good as the expensive one.
questions.aZh: 它只要 300 英镑，但当然没有价钱高的那种好。
questions.hint: 听 But, of course, ... 那句。

questions.q: What does Mrs Frith say about her husband?
questions.zh: 弗里斯太太是怎么抱怨丈夫的？
questions.a: She says he always wants the best, but they can't afford it — sometimes he thinks he's a millionaire.
questions.aZh: 她说他总是要买最好的，可他们买不起——有时候他以为自己是个百万富翁！
questions.hint: 听 You always want the best ... 那句。

questions.q: Why is Mr. Frith's last line 'Millionaires don't buy things on instalments!' funny?
questions.zh: 为什么「百万富翁是不会分期付款买东西的！」这句很幽默？
questions.a: It's a witty retort: since millionaires never pay on instalments, buying on instalments proves they are not millionaires — he's teasing his wife's complaint.
questions.aZh: 这是机智的反驳：既然百万富翁从不分期付款，那我们分期付款，恰恰说明我们不是百万富翁——幽默地回应了太太的挖苦。
questions.hint: 把妻子的逻辑反过来推一下。

questions.q: This ___ is ___, but that one is ___. / Is A as ___ as B? — No, A isn't as ___ as B.
questions.zh: 第 112 课操练：比较级与 not as ... as（平级比较的否定）。
questions.a: This book is cheap, but that one is cheaper. / The blue car isn't as clean as the red car.
questions.aZh: 这本书便宜，但那本更便宜。/ 蓝车没有红车干净。
questions.hint: 单音节词加 -er，多音节词加 more；否定平级在 as 前加 not。

quiz.q: 「这种型号比那种便宜些」正确说法是：
options: This model's less expensive than that one.
This model's more cheaper than that one.
This model's not so expensive that one.
This model's cheapest than that one.

A is not so good as well as B.
A is less better than B.
